change_reason: D4 rule coverage gap + unobservable REVERSION prerequisite (pre-validation)
new_rule: HOLD also for EXPANSION(quiet) ; REVERSION adds EXHAUSTION_BUILDING+POSSIBLE+break>=ELEVATED ; REVERSAL regime -> REVERSION on repeated touch

features.name: market_regime
features.definition: 由当时可见的多周期状态(趋势/区间/ER/ATR 分位/波动)映射到 TREND|RANGE|COMPRESSION|EXPANSION|REVERSAL|LIQUIDITY_STRESS|EVENT_DRIVEN|UNKNOWN
features.data_source: 本地 M15/H1/H4/D1 已收盘 bar + ATR/ER
features.PIT_rule: 仅使用 signal 时刻已收盘 bar
features.missing_data_behavior: 缺周期→该周期弃权并降级为 UNKNOWN

features.name: key_levels
features.definition: 5-bar 分形摆动点(左2右2)、区间边界(96根高低)、session 极值、波动极值；confirmed_at = pivot_time + 2 bar
features.missing_data_behavior: 不足 240 bar → 不输出新 level

features.name: touch_exhaustion
features.definition: 接触计数/穿透深度/近位时间/回收距离与速度/触碰后反应/反应衰减/触碰间隔 → FIRST_TEST|RETEST|REPEATED_TEST|EXHAUSTION_BUILDING|EXHAUSTION_CONFIRMED

features.name: absorption
features.definition: 冲击(活动量或tick数)上升后价格推进是否下降；**数据源=PROXY** → ABSORPTION_NONE|POSSIBLE|STRONG|FAILED
features.missing_data_behavior: 无 tick → INSUFFICIENT(不得输出 STRONG)

features.name: liquidity_state
features.definition: spread 分位 + tick 活动 + 价格响应 → STABLE|REPLENISHING|DEPLETING|WITHDRAWING|UNKNOWN（**PROXY**）

features.name: break_risk
features.definition: 证据集合(repeated_test/response_decay/absorption_weakening/liquidity_withdrawal/penetration/recovery_failure/momentum_accel) → LOW|NORMAL|ELEVATED|CRITICAL；必须输出 break_risk_evidence[]
features.missing_data_behavior: 缺证据→证据列表标注缺失

features.name: momentum_state
features.definition: 速度(Δclose/ATR,4bar)/加速度/区间扩张收缩 → SLOW|NORMAL|ACCELERATING|DECELERATING|EXHAUSTING

features.name: failed_event
features.definition: 突破尝试/确认/失败/收复的时间序列 → FAILED_BREAKOUT|FAILED_BREAKDOWN|FAILED_SUPPORT_BREAK|FAILED_RESISTANCE_BREAK|FAILED_RECLAIM（禁止单根 candle 判定）

features.name: state_transition
features.definition: 状态向量(regime,level关系,touch,absorption,liquidity,break_risk,momentum) 的相邻周期变化 → 下一可能状态集合
features.data_source: 上述各引擎 + 上一周期状态
features.PIT_rule: 上一周期状态必须来自 ≤t-1
features.missing_data_behavior: 上周期缺失 → 只输出当前状态

features.name: counter_evidence
features.definition: 对给定方向同时产出 SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE[] 与 COUNTER_EVIDENCE[]（禁止只收集支持证据）
features.missing_data_behavior: 证据缺失 → 记 UNKNOWN 而非省略

features.name: data_quality
features.definition: DOM/深度/逐笔方向缺失标记、spread 异常、bar 构造伪影、重复 tick、时间戳伪影 → 向上游传递
features.missing_data_behavior: 任何 UNKNOWN 必须显式传播
